newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends mixed, nearby March weak.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends mixed, nearby March weak.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended mixed, with nearby March closing weak after see-sawing throughout the session, traders said.

March firmed early as Rosenthal Collins, a commission house with large fund holdings, bought at least one million bushels. But Rosenthal's buying ebbed and March drew pressure from weaker cash basis bids for hard red winter wheat at Gulf and interior locations, traders said.
Traders said local brokers sold the March down to its intraday lows, but March firmed again at midday on buying by another commission house, Prudential Securities.
Traders said nearby March also weakened as players bought the CBOT/KCBT March spread.
KCBT wheat settled 1-1/4 cents lower to three cents higher, with March down 1-1/4 cents at $4.19-1/2 a bushel.
Rosenthal and Prudential each bought at least 1.6 million March on the day. Cargill Investors Services bought 1.1 million March bushels and also bull-spread 1.4 million March/May.
The KCBT March/May spread narrowed to close at just under 34 cents, compared to its close at 38 cents Wednesday.
